- redwood_dpa_v2_redlines.pdf (tracked changes + comments)
- subprocessor_inventory_202704.xlsx (exported list, contact + processing locations)
- data_transfer_matrix_medtech_202704.xlsx (mapping of MedTech data classes -> subprocessors -> transfer controls/SCCs)

Next steps for us: Marissa will attach the SOC 2 executive pack and pen-test summary by EOD; I can iterate the DPA language if MedTech has specific edits.

If helpful, we can schedule a short walkthrough of the matrix tomorrow to step through any items flagged by your security team.
